# fjordrun_team (Data Source)

A team, by `id` or `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fjordrun_team" "acme" {
  name = "Acme"
}

output "plan" {
  value = data.fjordrun_team.acme.plan
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Team ID. Set this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Team name, or slug. Set this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `founding_member` (Boolean) Whether it has founding member benefits.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace.
- `plan` (String) `trial`, `hobby`, `pro` or `enterprise`.
- `role` (String) The caller's role.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe name.
- `status` (String) `active` or `suspended`.
